critical_code_review_comments: projects.py line 196: _all_scenes_job calls _scene_job for scene 0 serially then gathers rest with it as reference image - good pattern for character consistency.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event; migrating to lifespan would be cleaner but non-blocking.
login_attempts lock uses ISO string comparison with now_iso() which works for UTC strings but is fragile - consider epoch comparison.
projects.py scenes_from_script resets scene.audio_path on any patch of script - intentional and correct.
